title: Print a part by chat
goal: "Print Smoke's feet" resolves drone, model, part, file and count, slices with the part's profile and asks approval for the Bambu Connect hand-off
acceptance: Italian and English phrasing; a drone name or a model name both resolve; an ambiguous part asks which one
Count comes from the part (feet x4, bands x2 one per side) unless the owner names a number; the plate or repeat count is stated before slicing
Default material TPU from the external spool with the profile's own temperatures; the reply names file, count, profile, time and grams; the hand-off stays an Orange action (F-087-T03)
A test across the join: chat request to slicer request to hand-off card, with a fake slicer
A missing library file is reported with the expected relative path and nothing is sent or sliced
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; the owner's part list and file paths stay in private fleet data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
